verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt containing agent-directed instructions, and markdown versions of the Connect docs (e.g. connect.md) return HTTP 200, so an agent can be pointed directly at them. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs, explicit evidence of Connect-specific coverage within llms.txt

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
